items.title: Gilead Sciences (GILD) Expands ADC Research With AI Tissue Analytics
items.summary: Gilead Sciences (NasdaqGS:GILD) announced a partnership with Nucleai to use AI-powered tissue analytics in its global antibody drug conjugate programs. The collaboration focuses on translational research to speed up biomarker discovery and support precision oncology development. The AI tools are intended to help standardize and accelerate analysis of tumor samples across Gilead’s oncology pipeline. items.title: 3 Healthcare Stocks with Open Questions
items.summary: Personal health and wellness is one of the many secular tailwinds for healthcare companies. Players catalyzing medical advancements have benefited from elevated demand, and their momentum is only rising as the industry has posted a 22.3% gain over the past six months, beating the S&P 500 by 11.2 percentage points.

items.title: GILD- An Attractive Biotech Stock with Solid Base Revenue Growth
items.summary: Gilead Sciences Inc. (GILD) just reported June quarter revenue up 10.2% from last year to $7.8 billion, ahead of estimates. Due to an $11.2 billion one-time write-off of acquired in-process R&D, they reported a $6.75 per share pro forma loss. But that was smaller than the negative $7.25 consensus expectation, notes Michael Murphy, editor of New World Investor.
